```{python}
#| label: fig-package-parasitics
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Equivalent circuit of a single package connection from the PCB to the on-chip pad: the bond wire and package trace contribute a series inductance and resistance, while the package trace and the bond pad add shunt capacitances. These parasitics limit bandwidth and cause supply bounce ($V = L\\,di/dt$)."

import schemdraw as sd
import schemdraw.elements as elm

sd.svgconfig.svg2 = False

with sd.Drawing(canvas='svg') as d:
    d.config(unit=2, fontsize=10)

    d += elm.Dot(open=True).at((0, 2)).label('PCB\npin', 'left')
    d += elm.Resistor().endpoints((0, 2), (2.5, 2)).label(
        '$R_\\mathrm{trace}$')
    d += elm.Inductor2().endpoints((2.5, 2), (5, 2)).label(
        '$L_\\mathrm{trace}$')
    d += elm.Dot().at((5, 2))
    d += elm.Capacitor().endpoints((5, 2), (5, 0)).label(
        '$C_\\mathrm{trace}$', loc='bottom')
    d += elm.Resistor().endpoints((5, 2), (7.5, 2)).label(
        '$R_\\mathrm{bond}$')
    d += elm.Inductor2().endpoints((7.5, 2), (10, 2)).label(
        '$L_\\mathrm{bond}$')
    d += elm.Dot().at((10, 2))
    d += elm.Capacitor().endpoints((10, 2), (10, 0)).label(
        '$C_\\mathrm{pad}$', loc='bottom')
    d += elm.Line().endpoints((10, 2), (11.5, 2))
    d += elm.Dot(open=True).at((11.5, 2)).label('chip\npad', 'right')

    d += elm.Line().endpoints((5, 0), (10, 0))
    d += elm.Dot().at((7.5, 0))
    d += elm.Ground().at((7.5, 0))
```
